in_marathi.name: Naitik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Naitik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Naitik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'naitiik', which means authentic or sincere. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who embodies truth and righteousness. The name is believed to inspire bravery, wisdom, and compassion in the one who bears it.
